title: NavigationLayout
description: Fiori navigation layout: header, collapsible side navigation and content; collapses the side navigation on small screens (ui5-navigation-layout).

usage.summary: Compose a full-screen header, vertical navigation and page content with responsive navigation visibility.
useWhen: Move between application sections through vertical navigation while keeping the current page beside it.
Compose the header, navigation and content regions of an application screen yourself.
Use mode="auto" to collapse navigation below 600px; wire onModeChange to close expanded navigation after selection on these screens.

avoidWhen.when: Need navigation items only inside an application frame that already exists.
Start from a wired frame with search, notifications, user menu and product switching.
Start from an application-entry scaffold with selected navigation and page placeholders.
Keep a record list and its selected detail visible as related pages.
Show supplementary context rather than application navigation beside a task.
